job.title: QA Manager / QP
job.description:
Global pharmaceutical company with a production facility in South Dublin are seeking an experienced QA Manager & Qualified Person to join their team.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced QP to take ownership of batch release, the QMS and managing a team of 5 across QA/QC function.

As QA Manager & Qualified Person, you will have responsibility for the batch release of sterile injectable products and ensure ongoing compliance with product licences and international regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Product Release, approving batch documentation, quality control and related (master) templates.
  • Reviewing compliance of production and analytical methods with GMP/HPRA guidelines, EP and SmPC.
  • Reviewing and approving deviations, QC tests and results, managing Out of specification results.
  • Investigate manufactured products in case of complaints or externally reported deviations.
  • Implement a Quality Culture: influence the site personnel and management and promote a culture of excellence.
  • Oversight of the Quality System, managing deviations, incidents and investigations, OOS, CAPA, Change control and release of incoming materials.
  • Continuous improvement of the QMS for purpose of regular gathering and trending of all quality related data.
  • Managing the continual improvement plan to ensure the site is always improving on quality.
  • Delivering and managing of the site Validation Master Plan, ensuring production occurs in a validated state.
  • Quality point of contact of regulatory inspectorates and ensuring inspection readiness at all times.
  • Assist the Production Manager and Site Lead to meet company objective and targets both commercially and ensuring operating with budgets whilst maintaining compliance.
  • Manage and develop QA/QC teams, including coaching, performance reviews, career development and succession planning.

Requirements:

  • Educated to degree level in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Biology or related.
  • Qualified Person and experience as QP on a HPRA license.
  • 5-10 Years Experience in QMS.
  • Experience in the overall management of staff.
  • Project leadership skills.
  • High technical aptitude as well as good communicative and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent and up to date working knowledge of current EU GMP and HPRA requirement for medicinal products.

It is a permanent role, 5 days on site.

  • Career Development
  • Analytical Skills
  • Coaching
  • Production Management
  • Change Control
  • Communication

  • Master Plan
  • Regulatory Requirements
  • EP

job.title: Senior QE
job.description:
Senior/Principal level Quality & Design Assurance Specialist/Engineer

Our medical device client is seeking an experienced Quality & Design Assurance professional to support its QMS, design control and supplier quality activities within a fast-paced, early-stage environment. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who can work independently, manage multiple priorities and collaborate across engineering, process development and external manufacturing partners.

This role is based in Cherrywood, South Dublin. Flexibility to be on site 3 days per week.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and improve the QMS, supporting GMP operations and GMP readiness.
  • Develop, review and approve SOPs, work instructions and technical documentation.
  • Manage change controls, deviations, CAPAs, root cause investigations and effectiveness checks.
  • Coordinate internal audits, track findings and ensure timely CAPA closure.
  • Oversee supplier quality, including supplier qualification, CMO audits, Quality Technical Agreements and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Review supplier documentation, including batch records, change notifications, validation and qualification records.
  • Support design assurance activities in line with ISO 13485, including design plans, design inputs and outputs, design reviews, verification and validation, FMEAs and Design History Files (DHF).
  • Coordinate design control documentation and track actions required to support product development and launch objectives.
  • Provide support for regulatory documentation and submissions, as required.

Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience working with Quality in medical device or biotechnology environments.
  • Practical experience using an electronic QMS platform.
  • Strong knowledge of ISO 13485 design controls and design assurance processes.
  • Demonstrated experience managing change controls, deviations, CAPAs and internal audits.
  • Experience in supplier quality management and working with contract manufacturing organisations (CMOs).
  • Excellent technical writing, organisational and project management skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities and adapt to changing requirements in an early-stage company.

Desirable/Advanced Experience:

  • Onboarding new CMOs, including supplier qualification and design transfer.
  • Working with single-use assemblies, moulded components or medical device sub-assemblies.
  • Software validation and lifecycle management.
  • Sterilisation assurance, biocompatibility or extractables and leachables.
  • Design engineering experience.
  • Knowledge of EU and FDA regulatory frameworks for medical devices and/or ATMP/CGT technologies.
  • Experience with Drug Master File (DMF) processes and regulatory submission preparation.
  • Effective use of AI tools to improve working efficiency, supported by appropriate critical review.

The Ideal Candidate

A proactive, technically strong Quality professional who combines hands-on QMS experience with design assurance capability. They will be comfortable working in a small, cross-functional team, engaging directly with internal stakeholders and external suppliers, auditors and regulatory consultants while helping maintain robust quality standards in a growing organisation.

job.title: Electronic Engineer
job.description:
Our medical device client, based on the east side of Galway, is seeking an experienced Electronic Engineer at Principal level to join a small, collaborative team. In this hands-on role, you will take ownership of electronic equipment design for medical interventions, contributing to projects from initial concept through to production. Responsibilities will include circuit design, simulation, testing and characterisation across multiple projects, while ensuring compliance with IEC 60601 regulatory standards. You will collaborate closely with mechanical and firmware/software engineering teams to develop innovative medical device products.

Responsibilities include:

  • Design, development and testing of PCBA and Schematic capture through Altium
  • Using LTSpice simulation tool to model and test circuits
  • Working with various electronic test and measurement equipment
  • Working closely with cross functional teams to meet shared objectives and deadlines

Ideal candidate:

  • 8 years of experience as an Electronics Engineer working in the medical device industry or a similar highly regulated industry
  • Working knowledge/building electronics to comply with 60601 regulations/standards
  • Bachelors of Engineering in an Electronics discipline
  • Hands on experience with design of printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), and tools like Altium
  • Using simulation tools like LTSpice

It is a permanent role based on site in Galway.

Competitive salary on offer depending on years of experience, along with benefits package.

job.title: Head of Financial Institution Sales (EMEA)
job.description:
Regional Head of Financial Institution Sales – EMEA

Location: London. However, candidates based elsewhere in the UK or Europe will also be considered

The business is seeking a senior commercial leader to take ownership of Financial Institution sales and strategic partnerships across EMEA. Reporting directly to the CEO, this is a highly autonomous, hands-on role for an established commercial operator who can bring a strong network and convert relationships into significant, long-term revenue opportunities.

This is not a high-volume or lead-generation-focused sales position. The successful candidate will originate, structure and close a small number of high-value partnerships across banking, payments, fintech, treasury services, cross-border FX and, potentially, digital assets.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the full commercial lifecycle, from origination and initial engagement through negotiation, implementation and revenue generation
  • Build and convert a regional pipeline of large Financial Institution and B2B partnerships
  • Develop senior relationships across banks, payment processors, fintechs, FX providers and large corporate treasury functions
  • Present cross-border payments, FX and payment infrastructure solutions to C-suite stakeholders
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations and structure tailored client propositions
  • Work closely with Product, Risk, Compliance and Finance to bring partnerships live
  • Take ownership of regional revenue, payment-volume and partnership-development targets
  • Represent the business as a trusted adviser within the European payments and financial services ecosystem

The successful candidate will likely have:

  • Significant senior-level experience in institutional sales, treasury sales, payments, banking, fintech or strategic partnerships
  • A strong and demonstrable network across Financial Institutions, payments, fintech or corporate treasury
  • A track record of personally originating and closing large, complex commercial partnerships
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payments, FX, treasury services or payment infrastructure
  • Credibility when engaging and negotiating with CFOs, treasurers and other C-suite decision-makers
  • The ability to operate independently and establish a regional commercial presence
  • Exposure to stablecoins or digital assets would be beneficial but is not essential

This is initially a senior individual-contributor position, with the opportunity to play a central role in establishing and developing the organisation’s EMEA commercial presence.

job.title: Engineering Manager
job.description:
Ready to spearhead a new market expansion and build a top-tier team from the ground up?

We have exclusively partnered with a leading UK travel business on this fantastic opportunity as they are creating a new Engineering team in Dublin and this will be their first expansion outside of the UK market.

I'm looking to speak with experienced Engineering Managers from a development background that will lead a team of 5-6 engineers while driving both technical execution and operational excellence while hiring and scaling a high-performing engineering team. The Irish office will have full ownership on the Inventory side of the platform which includes supplier integrations, inventory management, and booking reliability.

This is a remote friendly opportunity looking for people to come into the office once a fortnight in their city centre location.

What You'll Be Doing Day to Day

Our platform processes supplier connectivity, data acquisition, distribution, and booking workflows to ensure fresh, high-quality travel inventory with minimal latency in a high-traffic environment.

  • Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, grow, and mentor a team of engineers to deliver high-quality software while developing their careers.
  • Technical Strategy: Own the technical architecture for inventory management, ensuring scalability, resilience, and performance.
  • Backlog & Product Delivery: Own the team backlog, facilitating technical and product decisions in partnership with Architects, Designers, and Product Managers.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to improve supplier integrations, enhance data freshness, and streamline booking processes.
  • Engineering Best Practices: Champion standards for operational excellence, from CI/CD pipelines to system monitoring and incident response.
  • Hands-on Contribution: Contribute directly when needed by reviewing code, guiding system design, and tackling complex technical challenges.

What We're Looking For


  • Leadership Experience: Proven track record leading high-performing engineering teams, ideally within high-scale, distributed environments.
  • Core Technical Stack: Strong background in C# .NET (or Kotlin, Scala, or Java) with hands-on experience building cloud-native services on AWS.
  • Infrastructure & Automation: Experience using Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines for scalable, automated deployments.
  • Data Processing & Architecture: Background in large-scale data processing, internet-scale real-time data workflows, transactional systems, and GraphQL / modern API-driven architectures.
  • Observability & Reliability: Strong focus on monitoring, observability, system uptime, and performance optimization.
  • Pragmatic Mindset: Balanced approach to technical debt, feature velocity, and operational stability, combined with a passion for data-driven experimentation and decision-making.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Senior Backend Engineer (.NET / AWS)

job.title: Procurement Lawyer
job.description:
Our client a leading law firm is seeking to recruit two experienced Procurement Associates / Senior Associates to join their rapidly expanding Projects, Infrastructure and Energy group. The team has gone from strength to strength over the past 24 months with further growth and new business projected.

Work will include advising public sector bodies, utilities and local authorities, as well as private sector organisations, on a wide range of contentious and non-contentious procurement matters. Working across sectors, the group advise on all aspects of the procurement and contracting process. The team is also heavily involved in procurement disputes and litigation before the Irish Courts. You will be joining a dynamic practice group where hard work, collaboration and innovation are rewarded. Plenty of scope for progression.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Advising public and utility sector clients on all aspects of EU and Irish procurement law and national guidelines;
  • Supporting clients on strategic and high value projects in various sectors including energy, housing, transport and health.
  • Drafting and advising on complex procurement documentation and guiding clients through procurement processes, advising on evaluation methodologies, clarifications, debriefing and contract modifications;
  • Advising on contract drafting and negotiation;
  • Advising on Foreign Subsidies Regulation;
  • Advising private sector tenderers on bidding for public projects and contracts;
  • Advising clients (public and private) on procurement remedies and legal challenges before the Courts;
  • Delivering client training; and
  • Keeping up to date with legal developments in the procurement sphere and contributing to knowledge sharing and business development.

The Candidate
The ideal candidate will have 3-6 years’ PQE, with experience of advising on Irish and EU procurement law. You will be a highly motivated team player and have strong organisational and interpersonal skills as well as a good work ethic, energy, and enthusiasm.

Permanent role

Salary €60-80K (depending on experience)

On-site role

job.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
job.description:

  • ☁️ Secure Azure, AWS, and GCP environments
  • 🚨 Investigate complex security incidents and improve response capabilities
